published_prior_art.cite: BertsimasPopescu2005 + HalasehMagronSkomra2026 + BayerTeichmann2006: general moment duality, relative-interior attainment, and atomic compression, not this hierarchical causal fiber.
Wood1999BinomialMixtures: fixed-binomial mixture geometry but no iff criterion for constancy of a nonlinear four-cell causal functional on every fiber.
LeeWeidner2026: valid finite-order limited-pooling ATE envelopes, not optimization over the complete fixed-plate multinomial mixing fiber.

DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2023 and SachsJonzonSjolanderGabriel2022: automated symbolic/numerical causal bounds for finite discrete models, not exact continuous-latent Bernstein-fiber recovery with SCM witnesses.
BasuBrillYekutieli2026: exact inversion for univariate binomial-mixing CDF/quantile functionals, not a four-cell causal fiber or its semialgebraic confidence-set image.
Wood1999BinomialMixtures and HalasehMagronSkomra2026 leave the exceptional boundary geometry of the nonlinear ATE fiber unclassified.

novelty_flags.label: Theorems 4–5 / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: SachsJonzonSjolanderGabriel2022 is a direct published comparator for symbolic tight causal bounds but is absent from related_work and the theorem-level comparison; distinguish its finite response-function setting from the proposed continuous mixing-law CAD program.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3 and 5
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The strict-width and attained-dual claims are confined to fixed finite m and b in relint(B_{m,epsilon}); boundary fibers are expressly outside that headline regime.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The sharpness and nondegeneracy claims are accepted conditional on fixed finite m and relative-interior observable count laws.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 / technical_internal_limitation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The exact m=2 rational benchmark certificate is not assumed as a result; it remains a solver/implementation obligation within the retained boundary-atlas question.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: No headline theorem is taken to assert the outstanding m=2 certificate.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2111.05243v2, 13 Dec 2021; the Journal of Econometrics landing page confirms 2026 publication, but the publication PDF was inaccessible here.
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 17–18, equations (22)–(23) and Proposition 2; pp. 21–22, Section 4.1.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The preprint gives the stated odd/even limited-pooling weights, valid ATE bounds, and a sample construction requiring an order no larger than the number of observations sharing a covariate value.
Relative-interior generalized-moment data yield dual attainment, and Corollary 5.9 supplies a representing measure positive against every nonzero nonnegative continuous function.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics 35(2), 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article constructs pointwise exact confidence intervals for CDFs and quantiles of an unrestricted univariate binomial mixing distribution by inversion of composite tests.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 2024; published online 21 Aug 2023
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper reduces discrete causal queries to polynomial programs and uses dual relaxation plus spatial branch-and-bound to obtain valid bounds converging to sharpness.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics 32(2), 2023; published online 23 May 2022
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops symbolic causal bounds and identifies settings in which its method is guaranteed tight, making it a necessary comparator for the CAD/symbolic-bound claims.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1903.08999; published in Journal of Symbolic Computation 100 (2020), 38–71
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: CAD performs quantifier elimination over the reals, and equational constraints can reduce the decomposition complexity; it does not supply the proposal's causal finite-support reduction.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Sachs, Jonzon, Sjölander, and Gabriel as an explicit theorem-level comparator, stating precisely why finite response-function symbolic bounds neither subsume continuous mixing-law fibers nor yield the proposed finite-atom SCM certificate.

Sharpen the Lee–Weidner theorem with a checkable contact-set or exposed-face condition that characterizes exactly when the optimized Bernstein interval is strictly narrower, rather than only asserting existence of an open strictness region.

State an explicit input encoding and worst-case complexity/output-size bound for CAD_m and CAD_conf; this would turn the exact-recovery component into a stronger constructive-identifiability contribution.

recommended_next_step: Revise the literature comparison to include and distinguish SachsJonzonSjolanderGabriel2022, then advance the repaired field-tier fixed-plate fiber kernel to Stage 0.
